units: E_k:kWh; native delta_t:min converted to s; P_k=3600 E_k/delta_t_s=60 E_k/delta_t_min:kW.
classification: Derived from simulated HAULSIM event energy and duration.
assumption: Event energy is uniformly spread over its duration, including clipped terminal event.
audit: Dimensional and implementation checks passed; this is an event mean, not a measured transient or peak.
gap: An authoritative vendor definition of native export units was not independently located in this sub-audit; code comments and work/energy consistency support, but do not independently document, the adopted unit interpretation.

classification: Assumed equal power/nominal-energy rate mapped to a specified 2.5 Ah laboratory reference cell.
assumption: Power/nominal-energy equivalence is used as a reference-cell loading rate. The real pack current, cell chemistry/model/topology, operating voltage and current distribution are not identified.
audit: Code literally implements 2.5*power_kw/capacity_kwh. At fixed power, increasing nominal energy necessarily reduces I_eq; squared heating therefore decreases partly by construction.
gap: Units and computational agreement do not validate physical transfer. For E_nom=V_nom Q_pack/1000 and P=V I_pack/1000, I_eq=Q_ref*(I_pack/Q_pack)*(V/V_nom). In an ideal uniform pack whose cells have Q_ref, Q_pack=N_parallel Q_ref, so I_eq=(I_pack/N_parallel)*(V/V_nom). Actual per-cell current follows only with additional uniform-cell/sharing and voltage assumptions.

units: a=R_eff/C_eff:K/(A^2 s); b=UA_eff/C_eff:s^-1; g:dimensionless. Both right-hand terms are K/s. Differences in Celsius equal differences in kelvin.
classification: Reduced thermal-model assumption; a and b fitted to measured data from one A123 cell; g nominally assumed 1.
assumption: Single uniform state, constant effective coefficients, resistive-only heat and linear heat transfer to held air boundary.
audit: Frozen a=4.344635339312832e-5 and b=.002655462788692412 reproduced. Fitting is full pulse record, log-positive parameters, time-weighted least squares; evaluation records are same cell, different records.
gap: No separate R,C,UA identification: multiplying all three by any positive common factor leaves both ratios unchanged. No cell-to-pack scaling or core/hotspot state. Temperature/SOC-dependent properties, reversible heat, cooling controls and abnormal reaction heat absent. General battery-energy-balance citations do not establish these fitted ratios or the vehicle transfer.

equation: T_s(t+dt)=T_a+(T_s(t)-T_a) exp(-b dt)+(g a I_eq^2/b)(1-exp(-b dt))
classification: Exact analytic solution of Equation 3 for constant inputs.
assumption: Current, air, g,a,b constant within each event; initial temperature equals air in haulage scenarios.
audit: Independent excess-temperature recurrence using exp reproduces all 45094 stored nominal samples to max7.11e-15 C. One-second output samples add no demand information; event boundaries preserve extrema because constant-input segments are monotonic.
gap: Exact numerical integration validates the chosen ODE implementation, not the physical ODE or missing within-event load history. A single scalar g cannot reconstruct heat timing or peak response from unresolved current.

classification: Algebraic limit and characteristic time of the assumed thermal model; not a measured pack property.
audit: a/b=.0163611230 K/A^2; tau=376.5821929s=6.2763699min. Maximum event-mapped current2.525026A gives nominal steady excess .1043145332 C; realised common-window peaks .0429578069-.0931868854 C.
